title: Expressions of Love

questions.question: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, O noble what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:1 (ESV): "How beautiful are your feet in sandals, O noble daughter!"

questions.question: Your neck is like an ivory what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:4 (ESV): "Your neck is like an ivory tower."

questions.question: Your head crowns you like what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:5 (ESV): "Your head crowns you like Carmel,"

questions.question: I am my beloved's, and his desire is for whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:10 (ESV): "I am my beloved's, and his desire is for me."

questions.question: Come, my beloved, let us go out into the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:11 (ESV): "Come, my beloved, let us go out into the fields"

questions.question: Your navel is a rounded bowl that never lacks mixed what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:2 (ESV): "Your navel is a rounded bowl that never lacks mixed wine."

questions.question: Your belly is a heap of wheat, encircled with what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:2 (ESV): "Your belly is a heap of wheat, encircled with lilies."

questions.question: How beautiful and pleasant you are, O loved one, with all your what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:6 (ESV): "How beautiful and pleasant you are, O loved one, with all your delights!"

questions.question: Your stature is like a palm tree, and your breasts are like its what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:7 (ESV): "Your stature is like a palm tree, and your breasts are like its clusters."

questions.question: Let us see if the vines have budded... there I will give you my what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:12 (ESV): "there I will give you my love."

questions.question: Your eyes are pools in Heshbon, by the gate of what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:4 (ESV): "Your eyes are pools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bath-rabbim."

questions.question: Your nose is like a tower of Lebanon, which looks toward where?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:4 (ESV): "Your nose is like a tower of Lebanon, which looks toward Damascus."

questions.question: The king is held captive in its what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:5 (ESV): "The king is held captive in its tresses."

questions.question: I say I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:8 (ESV): "I say I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its fruit stalks."

questions.question: The mandrakes give forth fragrance, and over our doors are all choice what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 7:13 (ESV): "The mandrakes give forth fragrance, and over our doors are all choice fruits,"

key_verse_text: I am my beloved's, and his desire is for me.
